name: a-render-is-pinned-to-the-apps-appearance
breaks: the hosted render follows the machine's appearance again while the app pins itself to light, so on a Mac in dark mode the platform chrome (a Form's background, a TextField's bezel, a Picker) is drawn near black under the app's light type. Measured at brightness 0.119 against the app's 1.0, and no check catches it because the checks read the colours this app NAMES (#918, L504)
